status_definitions.reported: Imported QA claim, not independently reproduced or accepted by this intake.
status_definitions.expectation-review: An ambiguous claim or conflict with an existing requirement/exception; agree the expected behavior before fixing.
status_definitions.prior-measured: Supported by earlier 2026-10-06 measurements in this session, not a fresh retest or QA sign-off.

ticket_coverage_definitions.existing-open-scope: An existing open ticket explicitly addresses the reported kind of work; this does not confirm the claim.
ticket_coverage_definitions.related-open-scope: Open component/page-parity scope is relevant, but the individual claim may require an acceptance-criteria amendment.
ticket_coverage_definitions.partial-open-scope: Only part of the reported expectation is explicitly included in the open ticket.
ticket_coverage_definitions.closed-component-reference: Related implementation tickets are closed; no dedicated open fix is established by this mapping.
ticket_coverage_definitions.scope-review: Related open work has a phase/variant mismatch; do not assume it covers the M1 finding.

triage.policy: User-approved rough M1: material demo failures are M1; minor cosmetic/source-detail parity is M2.

priority_definitions.P1: Material demo failure or diagnostic needed to determine a potential core-flow failure; not a severity/confidence assertion.
priority_definitions.P2: Non-blocking polish, optional parity or go-live diagnostics.

groups.title: Restore image/video cart and rendition-download flows
groups.rationale: Add-to-cart and usable rendition downloads are mission-critical demo flows, not cosmetic parity. The three claims remain reported, not freshly reproduced.
acceptance: Reproduce the failing Images and Videos actions on identified sample assets; record type, rendition, request status and cart-state outcome.
Working sample assets can be added/removed, retain device-ID state and deliver their intended Original/1920 or video download. Preserve direct single download and the agreed client-side ZIP path.
Show real errors for unavailable assets. Do not substitute optimized display pictures for originals or silently report success.
#219 is a possible WebP-delivery dependency only after identifying a matching failing asset; do not assume it explains JPEG, PDF or video failures.

groups.title: Remove search and Peaq-resource dead-end navigation
groups.rationale: A visible demo action leading to 404 breaks the walkthrough. These four reports cover search submissions and the Peaq Images resource tile.
acceptance: Record the actual search-submit URL/query and Peaq Images-tile href; distinguish missing authored content, missing publication, alias rewriting and submit routing.
Each shown action reaches the intended working demo destination or the explicitly permitted live fallback, without a 404.
Respect the approved M1 URL set and link-containment policy. Do not import the entire press-kit corpus or build hosted/body-relevance search for M1.
Preserve encoded queries, back/forward behavior and safe external new-tab handling; retain a working keyboard-submit path.

groups.title: Resolve the search/navigation overlap
groups.rationale: Overlapping search and navigation is a conspicuous shared-layout failure. Keep the substantive header work in #144; do not move that whole issue to M2.
acceptance: Reproduce the overlap at the affected width/state and record the painted text/control boxes, not just padded link boxes.
Search and navigation remain readable and usable without horizontal overflow, including the desktop/compact transition.
Preserve keyboard, Escape, focus return, menu/drawer state and the existing mobile-nav accessibility work.
Small wordmark geometry, extra close-icon appearance, outside-click parity and footer cosmetics are proposed separately for M2.

groups.title: Prevent dates colliding with carousel navigation
groups.rationale: The four repeated reports describe unreadable overlapping dates/arrow hit areas during rail movement, not a small spacing or glyph mismatch.
acceptance: Reproduce each affected home rail while moving forwards/backwards; measure date, caption and navigation-button geometry.
Dates remain legible and do not intersect navigation hit areas in initial, intermediate and end positions.
Preserve drag, pointer/keyboard navigation, focus, reduced motion and long-title handling; do not hide dates or arrows to mask the collision.
Leave arrow shape, hover color, heading-tag parity and small date/title gaps to the separate M2 polish draft.

groups.title: Verify and restore missing footer legal destinations
groups.rationale: Missing required disclaimer links are a content/navigation gap, unlike footer typography or link-color differences. The report is not a legal-compliance determination.
acceptance: Inspect the currently published STO/MR footer fragments against origin; verify whether the four destinations are actually missing rather than merely worded/styled differently.
Where absent, restore Data Protection, Copyright, Cookies policies and Whistleblower system with the intended accessible labels and browsing context.
Keep internal sitemap links in the current tab and preserve safe external-link target/rel behavior.
If all four links already exist and only surrounding copy differs, document that result and defer copy polish to M2; do not blindly reopen #102.

groups.title: Triage material Images/Videos filter mismatches
groups.rationale: The source wording does not identify which filters are wrong. Investigate in M1 because unusable/wrong core filtering would derail the demo; do not claim a reproduced functional defect yet.
acceptance: Identify the exact missing/wrong facet or behavior on each listing, using the intended curated demo feed.
Opening, choosing, applying and clearing core filters must work, with truthful result counts and working load-more/sort behavior.
A sample having fewer terms/results than production is not itself a defect. Do not promise the full live corpus or production DAM-tag sync in M1.
Move label, checkbox, option-layout or small spacing-only discrepancies to M2 after diagnosis; retain only material behavior/layout failures here.

groups.title: Restore essential PR sidebar actions and quote layout
groups.rationale: The sidebar loses a real Media Box cart action; left-aligned quote content loses a conspicuous component layout. Keep material PR integration/flow work in #224.
acceptance: Restore the functional round add/remove Media Box action beside the label; a text anchor alone is not equivalent to the measured 40x40 source action.
Reproduce current quote alignment after the #140 implementation/content integration; restore the existing quote component rather than duplicate it.
After #148 content/panel work, reassess the existing large article-flow drift and resolve any conspicuous residual PR layout failure.
Preserve full-bleed dark bands. Their 16px separators, small prose/tag gaps, chevrons, label colors and short quote rules are M2 polish under this cut line.

groups.title: Preserve the Zellmer grey FAQ/highlight panel
groups.rationale: The sheet's background-color report overlaps #148's outstanding structured-callout integration and #224's large flow drift. A missing or flattened panel is material; a color-only difference is M2.
acceptance: Verify that the current imported page preserves the structured panel rather than flattening it into unrelated paragraphs.
Reuse #148 highlight/callout implementation and republish affected content if that is the missing integration step.
The recognizable panel, content order and readable article flow roughly match origin at the demo bands; do not compensate with arbitrary page-height spacers.
Re-measure #224 article/sidebar/Media Box anchors after the panel integration; remaining cosmetic precision stays in M2.
If the panel structure and layout already work and only its shade differs, defer that source subcase to QA266-M2-06 rather than treating color parity alone as M1.

groups.title: Correct oversized/misaligned first-glimpse accordion media
groups.rationale: Repeated oversized/unaligned images across the first-glimpse sections are a material layout defect. Reuse the shared accordion owner, with explicit editorial-variant coverage.
acceptance: Measure the first-glimpse image rows/columns when the reported sections are open; preserve intended reading-column sizing and content structure.
Fix genuine oversized/unaligned media using the shared primitive plus the actual editorial variant; do not blindly apply standalone FAQ-answer measurements to this page.
Preserve multi-open, keyboard, ARIA, focus, nested content and reduced motion. Do not emit FAQPage schema for editorial narrative.
Current GitHub #68 is M1 despite the older M2 header. This is an M1 variant-checklist proposal, not an expansion to the entire M2 press-kit program.

groups.title: Restore first-glimpse Media Box/video action surfaces
groups.rationale: The press-kit article loses an entire page-owned media toolbar and the sidebar collection action. These are missing functional surfaces, not provider-player styling.
acceptance: Reproduce the missing sidebar Media Box action and the absent plus/download/page-link row below the video.
Wire the existing media-action helpers using the authored asset identity/URLs; preserve real errors and do not invent asset metadata or fake-success placeholders.
Keep the existing lazy Vimeo embed and content order; do not rebuild Vimeo native controls or bypass consent/privacy behavior.
Coordinate with the listing/cart reliability draft; a changed provider-native play/volume alignment is the M2 half of the same original source observation.

groups.title: Restore the small homepage promo lead inset
groups.rationale: Accepted earlier measurements show an 8px lead-card inset/812px-vs-820px width difference, not a broken promo track. Minor visual alignment moves to M2.
acceptance: Use the existing #250 source measurements and scoped lead-card fix; preserve the matching track cap, right-hand cards and mobile full-bleed behavior.
Do not move global gutters or Latest Stories to compensate for the source-specific lead inset.
Check any remaining Latest Stories complaint independently; promote only a genuinely material layout failure.
groups.promotion_trigger: Promote if a distinct reproduced issue causes major misalignment, overflow, missing cards or a broken mobile promo; the known 8px inset alone is M2.

groups.title: Polish listing sort colors and bottom spacing
groups.rationale: The known 4px top-toolbar offset, active/inactive colors and small bottom gaps are cosmetic. Propose moving #248 and extending its checklist, not falsely claiming it already owns bottom pagination.
acceptance: Preserve the existing #248 measurements and independently verify active/inactive colors on both Images and Videos.
Measure bottom Load-more/count spacing separately; those four sheet claims are a proposed scope addition, not current #248 acceptance coverage.
Use the real curated-sample count; do not copy the live 12/1714 total or add production-scale search.
Preserve core filter/sort/paging behavior, grid bands, focus and contrast; accessibility failures are M1, not a reason to blindly copy source colors.
groups.promotion_trigger: Promote if the toolbar/pagination is inaccessible, overlaps content or stops working; small gaps/color differences alone remain M2.

groups.title: Polish shared teasers/rails and model-card ordering
groups.rationale: Arrow glyphs, hover/underline behavior, heading-tag parity, small date/title gaps and card ordering do not stop the rough M1 demo. Consolidate repeated reports instead of six rail-specific tickets.
acceptance: Reproduce per-variant title, date, hover/focus and glyph differences; use the shared renderer/styles rather than page-specific copies.
Check accessible heading hierarchy before changing h2/h3. Source tag parity alone is not proof of an accessibility defect.
Confirm the intended authored Models order before changing feed/curation logic; preserve card destinations and the selected demo corpus.
Keep the M1 date/arrow collision fix and focus/reduced-motion behavior. Do not remove accessible focus in pursuit of hover-only fidelity.
groups.promotion_trigger: Promote lost cards/essential content, unreadable overlap, broken navigation or actual heading/focus accessibility failures; not cosmetic tag/glyph/order differences.

groups.title: Polish Media Box/file tiles and non-image action parity
groups.rationale: Dates, h3 parity, menu/icon colors, file glyphs, toggle background and full-tile click affordances are minor. #173 M1 scope requires direct file downloads; its non-image cart hook was later work.
acceptance: Verify the actual source date/icon/title/control on each type; display only genuine available dates and do not invent timestamps.

Preserve working individual PDF/MP4 downloads in M1. Diagnose the requested full-tile click and PDF-cart eligibility separately instead of treating a visible disabled PDF add control as proof that downloading is broken.
Implement any approved non-image collection/ZIP extension with real original URLs, MIME/rendition eligibility and delivery/CORS checks; coordinate with M2 cart hardening rather than fake eligibility.
Scope icon/menu/type/toggle polish to the shared component and preserve current counts, lazy loading and Show-more behavior.
groups.promotion_trigger: Any missing/inaccessible PDF or MP4, broken existing download, hidden essential file/title or unusable Show more is M1. Cosmetic file-card differences and new non-image collection capability are M2.

groups.title: Polish header/search/footer details
groups.rationale: Wordmark appearance, extra close-icon presentation, outside-click parity and footer heading/hover/color details are minor unless reproduction exposes an unusable control or layout.
acceptance: Split these source-ID details from #144 without moving its substantive M1 overlap/overflow work.
Compare painted logo ink, not merely padded link boxes; a broken or wrong-brand image is promoted to M1.
Preserve accessible close/Escape/focus behavior; do not remove useful controls just because origin lacks them.
Verify footer semantics, typography and link states by component, preserving the M1 legal-content correction and destination behavior.
collision_scope: header CSS/JS and search dismiss state
groups.promotion_trigger: Promote a wrong/missing brand asset, overlap/overflow, focus trap, impossible dismissal, missing essential links or measured accessibility failure.

groups.title: Polish PR sidebar/prose and section separators
groups.rationale: Small tag/prose/card gaps, label/chevron styling, missing short quote rules and the measured 16px white band separators are non-blocking polish. Full-width green bands themselves match origin.
acceptance: Split the listed minor source-ID expectations from #224; keep its M1 essential-action/component-flow work.
Preserve two distinct full-bleed Media Box/Related sections; restore the measured 16px white separators without narrowing the green bands.
Use existing quote/sidebar/template implementations for small rule, tag-wrap, color and gap adjustments; no magic fixed-height compensation.
Check releases with/without Related, quotes and the grey callout after the M1 integrations.
groups.promotion_trigger: Promote actual merged/lost content, wrong-width structural bands, overlap or major residual flow/layout failure. The confirmed 0-vs-16px separator alone is M2 under the approved cut line.

groups.title: Polish press-kit/Series hero and bottom spacing
groups.rationale: The sheet requests 20px description text, roughly 34/30px gaps and less whitespace; earlier Series checks show 40px vs 10px at the footer. These are initially cosmetic, with a material-layout promotion gate.
acceptance: Measure hero/description/banners and the final visible tile/excerpt to footer, not just an image or an absolutely positioned article box.
Use fluid/tokenized component spacing; do not fix a large empty mobile area with viewport-specific magic offsets.
Retain the verified direction of the Series gap: demo is 30px larger, not smaller. Cover the in-scope Series hubs; include /en/series-2/ only if the separate navigation-scope extension is approved.
Promote the vague mobile whitespace claim before implementation if it is actually a conspicuous hero/content-layout failure.
groups.promotion_trigger: Promote if the mobile gap is grossly disruptive, hero/media is clipped, content is missing or the page overflows. Small 30/34px spacing/type differences stay M2.

groups.title: Polish first-glimpse sidebar/accordion/player details
groups.rationale: Chevron/tag/color differences, small accordion icons, optional hero-click parity and provider-control alignment are minor while the M1 article/media flows work.
acceptance: Polish sidebar tags/colors/chevrons and contact/download-link states without altering the M1 collection controls.
Preserve multi-open, ARIA/focus and the M1 image-layout correction when comparing the plus icon and editorial link styles.
Verify the intended hero-preview target and use the existing accessible gallery/lightbox rather than invent a viewer.
Compare like-for-like Vimeo player states before judging native control alignment; do not rebuild provider UI or confuse it with the missing page-owned toolbar.
groups.promotion_trigger: Promote if essential previews/downloads are unreachable, content layout is broken or focus/keyboard/contrast fails. Optional click-surface and styling parity alone is M2.

groups.title: Reconcile caption backdrop and image-fit exceptions
groups.rationale: Both claims intersect documented exceptions: the 56% black tile-caption contrast upgrade and cover-vs-fill image quality. Do not blindly remove the backdrop or stretch/crop media merely for source parity.
acceptance: Measure the exact Peaq hub and reported listing asset/context before deciding; earlier background comparisons were on Superb/Series, not a fresh Peaq capture.
Reconcile the sheet requesting #0000008F with the earlier user finding requesting transparent captions; retain the documented #141/PR #203 accessibility policy until a replacement is approved.
Compare image box, subject visibility, aspect ratio and the intentional object-fit quality exception; distinguish a wrong asset/severe crop from minor rendering policy.
Any policy replacement retains readable text and WCAG contrast. A source font stack or tag mismatch is not sufficient evidence of a painted-font defect.
groups.promotion_trigger: Promote unreadable captions, failing contrast, a wrong/missing asset or severe subject clipping. Cosmetic background/aspect-policy differences remain M2.

groups.title: Preserve the non-M1 Superb kit Twitter fallback/slot
groups.rationale: The all-new Superb kit is outside the current M1 URL set. Its previously measured missing fallback/layout slot is a separate user finding, not an Excel observation.
acceptance: Inspect source/current authored markup and restore the intended fallback/link and reserved layout slot using the existing integration policy.
Do not promise a live working Twitter feed: the earlier source iframe was 0x0 while the fallback/slot remained.
Do not bypass consent/privacy controls, import failed external-widget responses or build a new Twitter backend.
Keep #256 widget-autoblock and #261 Octavia reimport boundaries; neither is an existing Superb-slot restoration ticket.
groups.promotion_trigger: M1 only if the demo URL scope is explicitly expanded or the same underlying loss materially breaks an agreed M1 page.

groups.title: Diagnose reported SEO scores before go-live
groups.rationale: Seven reports show SEO 61/69 but contain no underlying audits or run conditions. That is a diagnosis task, not evidence of seven unique SEO bugs or an M1 demo failure.
acceptance: Obtain or rerun complete audits with URL, browser/Lighthouse version, viewport, throttling/cache, timestamp and code/content deployment identity.
Identify each failed SEO/best-practice audit and distinguish intentional preview noindex/crawling policy from real production metadata defects.
Scope production fixes only from the audit evidence; do not remove preview safeguards simply to improve a score.
M1 performance, accessibility and functional baseline remain under #42/#43/#44; their completion is not inferred from spreadsheet scores.
collision_scope: production head metadata and robots policy
groups.promotion_trigger: Promote an actual performance, security, accessibility or essential-content failure discovered by the audit, not a score delta alone.

supplemental_findings.source: Earlier user finding and 2026-10-06 serial origin/live measurements; not in the workbook.
supplemental_findings.finding: Series last visible tile/excerpt to footer: origin 10px, demo 40px. Demo is 30px larger, not too small.
supplemental_findings.evidence_scope: Motorsport hub at 375/768/992/1080/1280 x900; 130-years at1080; series-2 directory at1280.

supplemental_findings.source: Earlier user finding and 2026-10-06 serial origin/live/plain-markup inspection; not in the workbook.
supplemental_findings.finding: Origin retains Tweets by skodaautonews fallback/slot; demo loses link/embed/slot and repacks the tiles. Source iframe was 0x0, so a working feed is not established.

no_fix_dispositions.QA266-HOME-01: Pause/resume is explicitly required by SKODA-213 for accessibility. Retain it; presence is not a defect.
no_fix_dispositions.QA266-HOME-06: A declared fallback family alone does not prove the fallback is painted. No font-stack removal; verify actual glyph/metric problems under #44 and promote only a real material failure.
no_fix_dispositions.QA266-HOME-39: The statement itself says drawer-bottom languages are by design. No header-placement fix as stated; availability/routing follows #24/#243 and the approved locale scope, not all six production locales.
no_fix_dispositions.QA266-IMAGES-04: Original/1920 choices are part of the existing image-action contract. Retain the menu; the separate M1 action-flow reports determine whether selection actually works.

governance_notes: Existing GitHub milestones/acceptance criteria are unchanged. Split/move/extension proposals require approval at publication; grouping is not permission to close an issue under weaker criteria.
#144/#224 retain material M1 scope; only their minor checklists are proposed as M2 splits.
#250/#248 are currently M1; moving these cosmetic tickets to M2 is a proposal only.
#68 is currently M1 despite an older M2 body header. Its FAQ measurements do not prove first-glimpse editorial-image geometry.
All unverified imported claims remain unverified. Prior-measured evidence is dated, not fresh QA.
Original intake notes and ticket snapshots remain unchanged as historical import evidence; these additive triage assignments supersede their phase guidance.
Documentation may be committed in a PR for review without authorizing implementation-ticket or milestone changes. The separate uncommitted navigation-scope extension is not adopted by this PR.
